actions.description: Delete a problem comment
actions.name: delete-problem-comment

actions.description: Get full details (properties, tags, relationships) for a single monitored entity.
actions.name: get-entity

actions.description: Get the full descriptor (unit, dimensions, aggregation types) for a single metric.
actions.name: get-metric-descriptor

metricKey.description: The fully qualified key of the metric. Example: "builtin:host.cpu.usage"

actions.description: Get full details of a single problem.
actions.name: get-problem

problemId.description: The ID of the problem to retrieve. Example: "6853744532401203457_1785946260000V2"

actions.description: Get full details of a single security problem.
actions.name: get-security-problem

securityProblemId.description: The ID of the security problem. Example: "7412525767433554374" or "S-7"

actions.description: Get full details of a single SLO.
actions.name: get-slo

id.description: The ID of the required SLO. Example: "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-556642440000"

actions.description: Push a custom event (info, alert, or annotation) onto one or more entities.
actions.name: ingest-events

properties.description: Custom properties as key-value pairs. Values must be strings, numbers, or booleans.

startTime.description: The start time of the event, in UTC milliseconds.

endTime.description: The end time of the event, in UTC milliseconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in minutes before the event auto-expires. Defaults to 15.

actions.description: List API tokens configured in this environment (metadata only, not the secret values).
actions.name: list-api-tokens

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Must be between 100 and 10000. Defaults to 100.

actions.description: List monitored entities (hosts, services, applications, process groups, etc.) matching an entity selector.
actions.name: list-entities

entitySelector.description: Entity selector expression. Example: "type(HOST)". Required for the first page; omit on subsequent pages when passing cursor.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default: 50.

fields.description: Fields to include in the response. Example: "+properties,+tags,+fromRelationships,+toRelationships"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List all monitored entity types known to this environment with their properties and relationships schema.
actions.name: list-entity-types

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List events in a time window
actions.name: list-events

from.description: Start of the requested timeframe. Example: "now-2h" or "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

to.description: End of the requested timeframe. Example: "now" or "2024-01-01T01:00:00Z"

eventSelector.description: Event selector string to filter events. Example: eventType("PROCESS_RESTART")

entitySelector.description: Entity selector string to scope events to specific entities. Example: type("HOST")

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: Number of events per page. Max 1000.

actions.description: List/search available metric keys.
actions.name: list-metrics

metricSelector.description: Metric selector to filter metric keys. Example: "builtin:host.cpu.idle"

text.description: Search term to filter metrics by key, display name, or description.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Max 500.

actions.description: List configured network zones.
actions.name: list-network-zones

actions.description: List comments on a problem.
actions.name: list-problem-comments

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List detected problems in a time window.
actions.name: list-problems

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

from.description: Start of the requested timeframe. Example: "-7d" or epoch milliseconds.

problemSelector.description: Selector to filter problems. Example: status("open")

pageSize.description: Amount of problems per page. Max 500.

actions.description: List software releases/deployments tracked for monitored entities.
actions.name: list-releases

releasesSelector.description: A selector to filter releases. Example: entityName("order-processing")

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from a previous response.

pageSize.description: The number of releases per page. Max 1000.

actions.description: List detected security vulnerabilities (Runtime Application Protection).
actions.name: list-security-problems

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: The amount of security problems in a single response payload. The maximal allowed page size is 500.

securityProblemSelector.description: Defines the scope of the query. Only security problems matching the specified criteria are included in the response.

sort.description: Specifies one or more fields for sorting the security problem list.

fields.description: A list of additional security problem properties you can add to the response.

from.description: The start of the requested timeframe.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe.

actions.description: List configured objects for a given Settings 2.0 schema.
actions.name: list-settings-objects

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: Number of objects per page. Max 500.

actions.description: List available Settings 2.0 schema IDs
actions.name: list-settings-schemas

actions.description: List Service Level Objectives.
actions.name: list-slos

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: The number of SLOs per page. Max 10000 (25 when evaluate is true).

sloSelector.description: Filter SLOs by ID, name, health state, text, or management zone.

sort.description: Sort by name in ascending or descending order.

enabledSlos.description: Filter by enabled status: true, false, or all.

evaluate.description: Whether to evaluate SLOs. When true, maximum pageSize is 25.

actions.description: Query time-series data points for one or more metrics.
actions.name: query-metric-data

resolution.description: Desired resolution of data points. Example: "1h" or "120"

from.description: Start of the requested timeframe. Example: "now-2h" or "2021-01-25T05:57:01.123+01:00"

to.description: End of the requested timeframe. Example: "now" or "2021-01-25T06:57:01.123+01:00"

entitySelector.description: Entity scope of the query. Example: "type(HOST),entityId(HOST-123)"

mzSelector.description: Management zone scope of the query. Example: "mzId(123),mzName("name")"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageKey) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.name: update-problem-comment
